title: Strict cold performance benchmark for all-up Q8_0 CPU-compatible skip

bottleneck.component: Decode CPU up/down fallback plus source/page behavior
bottleneck.this_candidate_scope: Remove CPU fallback for ffn_up_exps.weight only. ffn_down_exps remains on CPU because down Q8_0 token-level correctness failed.

hard_bound.candidate_ceiling: Strictly below 11.367 tok/s because down fallback remains. This benchmark is expected to quantify how much up-only CPU-compatible skip removes from the current 19029.457 ms fallback bucket; it is not assumed to reach 10 tok/s.
hard_bound.promotion_threshold: Accepted only if eval_tok_s > 4.4 and all gates pass.

strict_cold_procedure.ram_guard: The run script samples memory.current and kills the process if it exceeds 16000000000 bytes; memory.peak, memory.stat file bytes, and memory.events are recorded.

command_skeleton: llama-cli -m DeepSeek-V4-Flash-FP4-FP8-native.gguf -p 'Please introduce France in a short paragraph.' -n 192 -c 512 -b 64 -ub 64 -t 20 -tb 20 -ngl all --fit on -fa auto --temp 0 --top-p 1 --top-k 1 --seed 1 --no-display-prompt --n-cpu-moe 40 --defer-experts -c 256 -b 16 -ub 16 -t 20 -tb 20

acceptance_gates.ram: memory_peak_bytes <= 16000000000 with file page cache counted in memory.stat
acceptance_gates.correctness: France answer must be semantic, coherent, and complete; exact output is recorded in summary.json
acceptance_gates.repro: If accepted, immediately commit+push source/artifacts, clean-rebuild, and reproduce from pushed source before promotion.

rejection_rule: If eval_tok_s <= 4.4, TTFT exceeds the gate, RAM/page-cache violates 16GB, OOM/swap occurs, or France output is incoherent/incorrect, record as rejected and do not change accepted SOTA.
post_run_analysis: Compare prompt/eval token rate, TTFT, memory_file_bytes, one-stream hit/miss counters, q80 skip records, and stderr CPU/GPU timing against the accepted SOTA. If up-only skip is insufficient, the next bottleneck is remaining down fallback/source behavior, not another up-only scope expansion.
